acceptance: Digest of an Arrow result equals the digest of the same rows fetched via fetchall (TPC-H SF0.01 on DuckDB).
Validation and first_row work on Arrow input.
Result metadata records fetch mode (rows|arrow) so runs are not compared across modes.
description: Query timing (base/sql_execution.py:77-86 and every adapter execute_query) wraps fetchall(), so client-side row building is counted as query time. compute_result_digest (sql_execution.py:104) and structural validation (result_capture.py:72-85,1014) expect a Python row list, so any Arrow fetch would be converted back to rows. Make these accept pyarrow.Table/RecordBatchReader (or convert lazily, outside the timer). Prerequisite for the Arrow fetch items.
